tasks.titleDe: Hör zu: Leonies Ausflug ins Museum

audio.script:
Last Tuesday was not a good day for me. Well, the morning was very good.
Our class was at the museum at nine o'clock. There was a new exhibition of modern art, and everybody wanted to look at it. Our teacher, Mrs Smith, had the tickets. The admission fee was three pounds for children. I also bought a picture book for five pounds. That was quite expensive, but the pictures in it were awesome.
"Leonie, come and look at this!" Mrs Smith called. She was in the first room, next to a red glass box.
The rooms were big and the art was very modern. In the second room there was a white plate on the wall, and everybody asked why. In the third room there was a black sculpture of a horse, and it was my favourite, because it was so big.
Then I looked at a chair near the door. There was a brown jacket on the chair. The jacket was dirty, and it was such a funny thing in a museum. Was it art? Was it worth a lot of money? I didn't know. So I called my best friend David.
I asked him about the funny thing near the door, and David laughed and laughed. He wanted to know if it was dirty. It was very dirty, and there was no price next to it. And then David knew, and I knew it too.
It wasn't a sculpture at all. It was the jacket of the cleaner. She was in the third room, and her jacket was on the chair. The jacket and the chair were not part of the exhibition.
Then Mrs Smith was next to me. "What's the matter?" she asked. I didn't tell her, because I was so embarrassed.
We were back at school at two o'clock. In the afternoon my mum asked me about the museum, and I talked about the horse and about the picture book. I didn't tell her about the jacket. Now you know it too. It is my secret, so please don't pass it on!

predictChips: Jemand erzählt von einem Ausflug ins Museum
Jemand erzählt von einem Streit mit einer Freundin

items.hintDe: Worum geht es im GANZEN Text — nicht nur in einem Satz?
items.explainDe: Gleich am Anfang: „There was a new exhibition of modern art, and everybody wanted to look at it.“

cue.quote: There was a new exhibition of modern art, and everybody wanted to look at it.

items.trickDe: Der Anfang nennt fast immer das Thema.

distractorMeta.whyDe: Du hörst school — aber nur am Ende, auf dem Rückweg.
Das schwarze Pferd kommt vor — es ist nur eine Skulptur von mehreren.
David wird genannt, aber er ist nicht das Thema.

prompt.text: Leonie's class was at the museum at ___ o'clock.

items.hintDe: Im Text stehen vier Zahlen. Welche gehört zum Museum?
items.explainDe: „Our class was at the museum at nine o'clock.“ — die Zwei gehört zur Rückkehr in die Schule.

cue.quote: Our class was at the museum at nine o'clock.

items.trickDe: Hör auf das Wort direkt nach der Zahl.

prompt.text: Why was the black horse Leonie's favourite?

distractors: Because it was near the door
items.hintDe: Warte auf das Wort because — der Grund kommt danach.
items.explainDe: „In the third room there was a black sculpture of a horse, and it was my favourite, because it was so big.“

cue.quote: In the third room there was a black sculpture of a horse, and it was my favourite, because it was so big.

items.trickDe: Nach because kommt der Grund — dort liegt die Antwort.

distractorMeta.whyDe: Schwarz ist die Farbe, nicht der Grund.
Very modern hörst du — aber über die ganze Ausstellung, nicht über das Pferd.
Near the door steht im Text — aber beim Stuhl, nicht beim Pferd.

items.hintDe: Zwei Preise und eine Uhrzeit. Welche Zahl gehört wohin?
items.explainDe: „The admission fee was three pounds for children.“ — und das Bilderbuch kostet fünf.

cue.quote: The admission fee was three pounds for children.

items.trickDe: Merke dir zu jeder Zahl das Wort daneben.

prompt.text: Who was the owner of the brown jacket?

items.hintDe: Die Auflösung kommt erst nach dem Anruf bei David.
items.explainDe: „It was the jacket of the cleaner.“

cue.quote: It was the jacket of the cleaner.

items.trickDe: Hör bis zum Schluss — die Auflösung kommt spät.

prompt.text: Sortiere: Was gehörte zur Ausstellung — und was nicht?

items.hintDe: Zwei Dinge standen im Museum und waren trotzdem keine Kunst.
items.explainDe: „The jacket and the chair were not part of the exhibition.“ — ein Satz, der beides klärt.

cue.quote: The jacket and the chair were not part of the exhibition.

items.trickDe: Ein Satz mit not trennt hier alles.

prompt.text: Why didn't Leonie tell Mrs Smith about the jacket?

distractors: Because she wanted to ask David first
Because she didn't like the exhibition
items.hintDe: Warte wieder auf because — diesmal kurz nach der Auflösung.
items.explainDe: „I didn't tell her, because I was so embarrassed.“

cue.quote: I didn't tell her, because I was so embarrassed.

items.trickDe: Das zweite because steht direkt hinter der Frage der Lehrerin.

distractorMeta.whyDe: David hatte sie schon aufgeklärt — noch einmal fragen musste sie nicht.
Leonie erzählt später vom Pferd und vom Buch — die Ausstellung mochte sie.
David lacht — aber am Telefon, vorher, und er ist nicht der Grund.

prompt.text: Our teacher, Mrs Smith, had the ___ .

items.hintDe: Was braucht eine Klasse, bevor sie ins Museum darf?
items.explainDe: „Our teacher, Mrs Smith, had the tickets.“

cue.quote: Our teacher, Mrs Smith, had the tickets.

items.trickDe: Wer hat was? Die Person steht vor der Sache.
